en: So this is the ruin that's\nrumored to be able to recreate\nmemories. It's pretty spacious.
The enemies seem formidable\nas well. Stay alert.
Okaaay. Got it!
You have no sense of urgency.
That's not true~! My brain is\nworking at full capacity, I\npromise~!
I highly doubt it.
Still...

Since the Captain brought me
instead of Tynave to explore
these ruins, does that mean
you trust me more?
Of course!
No, Tynave is more...
I was curious about Farleen's\npast
I'm happy to be trusted! I won't\nlet you down!
Hmm, maybe I didn't put myself\nout there enough? I'll do my\nbest to earn your trust.

Hehe, what is it, Captain? Are
you just fascinated by me?
Now, now, you mustn't make
Lady Nel or Lady Clair jealous.
Farleen has a bit of a rivalry\nwith Tynave, huh? I didn't\nnotice that about her before...
Hehe, is that how it looks?
...Oh! What a strange sensation.\nSo this is that thing everyone\ntalks about...

Come to think of it, things were
a bit chaotic when we first
met, so let me introduce myself
properly.

My name is Tynave, and this is
Farleen. We are both members
of the Demon Sealing Corps
"Darkness," serving under Lady
Nel.
It's a pleasure to meet you.
This is a memory of when I\nintroduced myself to Fayt in\nthe riverside village of Alias.
For the record, I'm mainly in\ncharge of the physical labor.\nAnd Farleen over there is...
In charge of the intellectual\nlabor.
Exactly! And since we're in the\nsame unit, we both get the\nsame pay.
What!?
Wait... is that not how it\nworks?
I'm so sorry, this is such a\ntrivial memory.
Tynave looked absolutely\ndevastated...
Well, Tynave never received\nformal military training.
I was hired because my\ntraining gave me a bit of an\nedge.

But the Aquaria army is a
meritocracy, so Tynave might
actually be earning more than I
am now.
So as long as you have the\nskill, you can rise through the\nranks. Not a bad environment.
Yes! Plus, I have the best\ncompanions and the strongest\nrivals.

Hmph. I suppose you're saying
that true strength cannot be
found by shutting yourself
away in your own world.
It's precisely because you have\ncomrades to push you that you\ncan improve yourself.
Tynave and I will keep working\nhard to get stronger and earn\nlots of money!

And above all, I want to earn a
more important position so I
can be of use to Lady Nel,
Lady Clair, and everyone else.
Please look forward to it,\nCaptain!
...Looks like it's my turn next.
Hey there, Edge.
Hey, Edge. Cutting off the\ncomms like that was cold.

This line is not for the Captain
of the Karnas. Or do you have
some business with a mere
crew member?
Captain Crowe F. Almedio of SRF Spaceship 001, the Accura.
note: the engine merged the ship and the captain ("the Accura Crow, F. Almedio")

en:
Playing the obedient crewman
doesn't suit you, Edge. More
importantly, you skipped the
departure ceremony, didn't
you?

Brings back memories. This
was right before we set sail
into the sea of stars for the
first time.

Were Crowe and Edge really
just joking around like this
during such an important
moment?
You seem quite relaxed. Wasn't\nthis right before a very critical\nmission?
Nah, I was so nervous my heart\nwas practically leaping out of\nmy chest.

We were short on fuel, after all.
That was the first time we
actually launched the ship for
real instead of using a
simulator.
And... back then, I...
...Anyway, I just really wanted\nto hear Edge's voice.
Hey, Edge. Do you really dislike\nthe fact that I became the\ncaptain that much?
...It's not that. I think it's only\nnatural that you were chosen\nas captain, Crowe.
It's just... that the gap between\nus has widened once again...
Ah, I get it! You're just trying\nto show off that you beat your\nrival, Edge!
N-no! Why on earth would I\nhave to claim something like\nthat?!

But the feeling of superiority
when you win is just
irresistible, isn't it? If you just
soak it in, all your nerves will
just blow away!
...She's surprisingly calculating.
I can see why Tynave has such\na hard time...
You know it too, right? How\ncritical the role of us SRF\nmembers is.
Whether I'm the captain or not,\nthe weight of the responsibility\ndoesn't change.
I'm just like you. Believe it or\nnot, I'm actually pretty nervous.
Crowe, nervous? It'll probably\nrain shooting stars tomorrow.
Stop mocking me. Well, look...\nwhat I mean is... let's both give\nit our all.
...Yeah, I guess so.
All right! That's all I wanted to\nsay. It's about time. Bon\nvoyage!
*Sigh*... Edge really is way more\ncomposed than I am.
...Ever since we were kids, he\nwas always the one doing big\nthings.
But... this time, I'm the one\nwho's going to...!

Captain, using
the comms for personal
matters is a violation of
regulations. Please focus on
the launch preparations.
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Accura Crew: "

en: Yeah, yeah, my bad. I was just\ngiving myself a little pep talk.
Well then, time to get to work.
Everyone at your stations. SRF\nSpaceship 001 Accura,\npreparing for launch!
Hehe, it seems Crowe really\ndoes see Edge as a rival after\nall.

Well, partly because of the
genes in my body, I've spent a
lot of my life being compared
to others.
Did you open this channel\nspecifically to listen to the\nvoice of your rival?
To me, Edge is a rival, but also\na comrade who shares the\nsame dream.

Of course, everyone on the
Accura is a comrade too, but
back then, I'd just been
suddenly appointed captain
and felt a bit inadequate.
I wondered if a punk like me\nshould really be acting as\ncaptain...

I thought that by talking to him,
I could remind myself that
we're all comrades looking in
the same direction.
So you were pretending to\nadvise Edge, when in reality,\nyou were talking to yourself.
I'm pretty pathetic, aren't I?
A rival is sometimes like a\nmirror that reflects oneself.

But you're kind of mean too,
Crowe. I bet Edge got really
flustered by your act of playing
it cool, didn't he?
Well, that's just how it is. After\nall, I'm the "Onii-san."
A comrade, and a rival...
Are you thinking of him?
Do you have a rival too, Dias?
I won't lose!
...Ah, you can tell?
Of course! We've been together\nlong enough that I can tell\nthings like that.
Captain, isn't that a bit too\noblivious, even for you?
When it comes to Dias's rival,\nit's obviously that person.
Ooh~. Captain, are you\ndeclaring yourself Dias's rival?

It's true that we've never
fought, even in training. Once
we leave these ruins, a match
wouldn't be a bad idea.
Oh, nice. Captain, what are you\ntwo competing in?

What? A banana-slicing
contest? You intend to soil my
blade with fruit? I could just as
easily use you for a test cut.
Waaaah! No test-cutting\nallowed here!

Well, no matter how much the
Captain insists, he's still the
only one who can be called
Dias's true rival.

My family was killed by bandits,
and I believed that by staying
alone, I could grow strong
without hurting anyone.

No, that's not it... I believed I
had to become strong on my
own, and that doing so would
be my atonement.

He showed me that there is a
strength that can only be
gained when you are with
others, and when you have a
desire to protect your
comrades.

Yeah, it's hard to exert your
full power just for yourself or
for some stranger you've never
met.

It's when there's a smile you
want to protect that fighting
with everything you've got
becomes worthwhile.

That's right. Because I have
family and friends back home I
want to protect, I can steel my
resolve and head into the fray.
Hmph. It seems you all share\nthe same convictions as he\ndoes.
Speak of the devil... here they\ncome.
You're an interesting one. You\nget worked up so quickly\nwhenever it comes to Rena.

But when it comes to battle,
I'm dead serious. Once we
enter the arena, I won't give an
inch.
I'm counting on it.

And now, the
moment you've all been waiting
for! The grand finale of this
year's Lacuer Martial Arts
Tournament!!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Announcer: "

en:
So this was the final of the
Lacuer Martial Arts
Tournament. Back then, I was
still obsessed with strength
through raw power alone.
Hah!!
Gah!
Impressive as always, Dias.\nHe's really putting the pressure\non.

But Claude isn't backing down
either! He's looking for an
opening in Dias's attack to
strike a vital point!
Helm Splitter!!
Gah!
Nice move! But you're still\ngreen. Don't think you've won\nyet!
*Pant*... *pant*... As expected\nof Dias.
...Um, Dias? Didn't you just lose\nto Claude?
...I just stumbled for a moment.\nNow the real fight begins.
Here I come.
Helm Splitter!!
Impossible... I, of all people...
Phew... Not bad! But you're still\ngreen. Don't think you've won\nyet!
*Pant, pant*... As expected of\nDias. Here I come.
Helm Splitter!!
Gwaaaah!!
*Pant... pant...* N-not bad...\nBut... you're still green. Don't\nthink you've won yet...!!
*Pant, pant*... As expected of\nDias. Here I come.
The winner of this\nyear's Lacuer Arms\nTournament has been decided!!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Announcer: "

en:
This year's
champion is Dias Flack!
Everyone, please give him a
round of applause!!
note: prefix (en-prefix 2026-10-08): removed the engine's speaker prefix "Announcer: "

en: And so, by weathering every\none of Claude's attacks, I have\nachieved a complete victory...
How dirty.
So immature.
What?!
That's exactly why nobody on\nthe ship will play cards with\nyou.
Because he makes us play until\nhe wins, and he gets angry if\nwe hold back...
I cannot allow a battle to end\nin defeat! Wouldn't you agree,\nCaptain?!

This story has come to an end.
More stories will be released in
the future. Please look forward
to them.
